spec: docs/CONTINUATION_2026-09-06_OPUS_PROMPT.md 2d.2 -- revive daily_autopsy on the after-close schedule; the second question becomes the opportunity-recall ledger with typed misses

was: daily_autopsy printed a one-line complaint, returned 1 and wrote NOTHING when the universe was empty
it dated its receipt from `max(bar['t'][:10])`, so a night with no bars wrote `state/autopsy/None.json`
discovery_autopsy had exactly one exit path and wrote a receipt only on the happy one

the after-close block stamped `last['autopsy'] = now` UNCONDITIONALLY, so one non-zero exit lost the whole night -- the next attempt was 20 hours away, by which time the 16:00-20:00 ET window had closed
now: the session day is DERIVED from alpha.exits.session_day() (the repo's one clock), and the bars only CONFIRM it; a mismatch prints a note naming both
every exit path of both scripts writes state/autopsy/<day>.json through ONE writer, with status ok | EMPTY | REFUSED and the reason
the after-close block retries after 30 min on failure and holds the 20h lock only on success
the ET hour comes from alpha.exits.ET_OFFSET instead of a second inline `(utc.hour - 4)`

proved_live.refusal_path: AAT_ACCOUNT_ROLE unset -> `DISCOVERY AUTOPSY 2026-09-04: REFUSED -- CredentialRefusal...` and a receipt on disk
proved_live.ok_path: daily_autopsy --no-llm ran 3,056 names, filed under session 2026-09-04 while the clock day was 2026-09-05, and printed the note

2_opportunity_recall_ledger.written_to: state/opportunity_recall/<day>.jsonl, one row per mover, both sides of the tape

typed_misses.NOT_OBSERVED: never entered any AEGIS list. The repair is COVERAGE.
typed_misses.GENERATED_NOT_RANKED: we had the name; the ranking did not surface it. The repair is the MODEL.
typed_misses.RANKED_NOT_BOUGHT: the sealed book named it and no fill exists. The repair is EXECUTION or an admission gate -- the class hack3 lost ten names in on 2026-09-03.
typed_misses.BOUGHT_SOLD_EARLY: closed inside the contract's minimum hold. The repair is the EXIT RULE -- 60% of round trips finished the session they opened.

2_opportunity_recall_ledger.both_sides: every mover carries recall_kind: missed_winner / captured_winner / avoided_loser / held_loser, and summarise() reports winner_recall BESIDE loser_avoidance. Either alone is maximised by a book with no discipline -- buy everything and recall is 1.0.
refusals_that_matter: sold_early is TRI-STATE: None means 'held, or cannot tell'. An UNTYPED exit row (written before 2026-09-05) is NOT counted as sold-early -- absence of a code is not evidence of one.

no seal for the day => `ranked` is UNKNOWN and the whole day is written UNCLASSIFIED. Treating it as an empty ranking would type every observed name GENERATED_NOT_RANKED and blame the MODEL for a night the seal never ran.
no decisions ledger => `bought` is UNKNOWN, same treatment; otherwise everything ranked would type RANKED_NOT_BOUGHT and blame EXECUTION.
a rate over zero movers is None, never 1.0 (the 312-wins-on-$0.00 lesson).

3_the_whole_market_was_seven_names.fix: discovery_autopsy takes the UNION of the screener and daily_autopsy's universe movers; every row records `mover_source`. 7 -> 23 movers on 2026-09-04.
